## Enters Mumbai to Set a New Benchmark in Luxury Living

SOBHA Ltd. receives RERA approval for its first project in Mumbai, featuring 310 premium residences in Parel.

Mumbai, 24 th November 2025: SOBHA Limited, India’s leading real estate brand renowned for its backward integration model and construction excellence, announces the launch of its first project in Mumbai - SOBHA Inizio. Spanning 1.038 acres, this landmark development is set within an emerging metropolitan hub, redefining luxury in Mumbai’s new era, where urban evolution, sustainability, and seamless living converge. With 310 residences, the project brings SOBHA’s signature luxury living experience to one of India’s most design-forward markets.

Situated along the Eastern Waterfront at the foot of Atal Setu, SOBHA Inizio offers luxurious 1, 2, and 3 BHK residences soaring across 64 floors. Designed for elevated living, the residences offer panoramic orientation, with all 2 & 3 bed homes capturing views of the Atal Setu Bridge and gorgeous waterfront vistas. Enhancing vertical grandeur, the 63rd floor has premium clubhouse amenities including a Fitness Centre, Games Lounge, Changing Rooms, and Salon. Crowned on the 64th floor residents can experience a range of indulgent offerings such as a serene swimming pool with an expansive deck and rejuvenating spa facilities. Complementing this, there is dual access points and a thoughtfully planned 360-degree driveway circulation system ensuring seamless mobility.

The location provides easy connectivity to Lower Parel, Worli, BKC, Nariman Point, and Navi Mumbai, with the recently inaugurated Navi Mumbai International Airport just minutes away via the Sewri–MTHL corridor, further strengthening the project’s strategic advantage.

Residents will also enjoy a dedicated space featuring layered lifestyle amenities including an Activity Lawn, Seniors’ Cabana, Sky Lounge, Alfresco Deck, Outdoor Fitness Corner, Pickle Ball Court, Board Walk, and a spectacular sky-borne Pool, offering a well-rounded recreational and wellness experience.

Key Highlights of SOBHA Inizio:

• Land Area: 1.038 Acres (4203 sqm)

Commenting on the launch, Mr. Nisanth MN, Deputy Managing Director, SOBHA Limited, said, “Stepping into Mumbai is a defining moment for us at SOBHA. This is a city shaped by global perspectives, refined taste and a deep appreciation for well-crafted homes. For over three decades we have focused on creating developments where every detail, from materials to engineering, is thought through with precision. Bringing that philosophy to Mumbai allows us to engage with one of the most sophisticated buyer communities in the country, and we are committed to creating a landmark that stands apart for its authenticity and craftsmanship.”

This launch underscores SOBHA’s vision of delivering timeless developments that elevate lifestyles and inspire future-ready urban communities.

About SOBHA Limited: Founded in 1995, SOBHA Limited is the only leading real estate brand in India that offers international quality homes, and commercial and contractual projects delivered on time, through its backward integration model. The SOBHA DNA hinges on customer-centricity built on a foundation of strong values of trust and transparency. The unwavering commitment to continually raising and bettering quality standards through relentless execution and technology adaptation have helped the company cumulatively deliver over 148.02 million square feet of developable area across 27 Indian cities. SOBHA has been recognised for implementing class-leading sustainability practices, adhering to the highest safety standards and making significant contributions to communities though its CSR efforts. The Company epitomises‘Art of Perfection’, instilled in each of the 4,650 strong Sobha-ites across its offices and manufacturing units.

### MANUFACTURING

The Backward Integration model, pioneered by SOBHA, stands as the epitome of strategic brilliance and industry differentiation. This vertically integrated approach bestows the company with complete autonomy, enabling it to seamlessly control every facet of project delivery—from conception to execution. By harnessing its own vast array of resources, SOBHA ensures the highest standards of quality, with no compromise on the precision, durability, or timeliness of its projects. The model encompasses world-class facilities, including one of India’s largest woodworking factories, a state-of-the-art metal works and glazing factory, a precast unit, a stonecraft facility and an advanced concrete products factory. 

Spanning an impressive 55,000 sq. m., these cutting-edge manufacturing hubs, equipped with the latest automated technology, produce materials of unmatched excellence. Beyond fulfilling its internal needs, these self-sustaining units serve as revenue-generating assets, supplying the finest materials to the nation’s prominent real estate giants, further solidifying SOBHA’s preeminent position in the real estate market. 

### SOBHA INTERIORS

This sprawling 3,75,000 sq.ft. facili ty produces the world-class interior solutions for end-to-end execution of homes, offices, hospitality and education spaces. With Bengaluru as its core and Biwadi serving NCR, it is managed by leading industry experts to deliver durable finishes and on-time handovers. Upgraded infrastructure and machinery now support a monthly capacity of 70 home interiors and 7,000 doors. 

### SOBHA GLAZING AND METAL WORKS

Covering an expansive 1,00,000 sq.ft., t his fac ility produces our state-of-the-art aluminium doors, windows and glazing systems in the country. Driven by advanced C omputer Numerical Control (C NC), laser and mite r fabrication, it executes stunning intricacies in façade design with precision. Producing 950 sq. m. of fully assembled façades each day, the ISO-led processes have earned appreciation for handling architecturally demanding projects. 

### SOBHA CONCRETE PRODUCTS

Spanning 55,000 sq.ft., t his est ablishm ent manufactures concrete blocks, pavers, kerbs, water drainage channels, paving slabs and related landscape products of international quality in large– scale volumes. Bengaluru and Gurugram mark its long-standing presence, now joined by Krishnagiri in Tamil Nadu. Daily production exceeds 12,500 sq. ft., complemented by ongoing material innovation alongside Nati onal A erospac e Lab or atories (NAL). 

### SOBHA RESTOPLUS

Launched in 2007, SOBHA’s Restoplus is a brand of spring mattresses envisioned to revolutionise the way we experience rest. Meticulously crafted to meet the demands for modern sleeping solutions, each mattress embodies the perfect blend of comfort, durability, hygiene, and refined aesthetics. 

With 275 franchises across the nation, Restoplus has witnessed remarkable growth, with sales distributed between luxury institutions such as high-end hotels and expansive projects, and franchisee outlets in a 30:70 ratio. The price range spans from ₹10,000 to ₹4 Lakh for tailor-made creations, offering complete freedom of choice in size, thickness, shape, foam type, and fabric.

It continues to dominate key markets, with Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, and Andhra Pradesh leading the way as the primary regions for SOBHA’s luxurious sleep solutions.

Discover the art of fine sleep at the SOBHA Restoplus website.

### SOBHA STONECRAFT 

Encompassing 32,483 sq.ft., this cutting-edge granite processing powerhouse, operational since 2023 in Hoskote, Bengaluru blends high-precision C omputer Numerical Control (CNC) technology with tailored finishes to deliver extraordinary architectural solutions. With a production capacity of 4,500 sq. m. monthly, it is poised for unparalleled craftsmanship and timely delivery. 

### SOBHA PRECAST

The 73,000 sq. ft. Precast Factory reinforces th e foundation of the homes by manufacturing key load– bearing elements in a precision driven environment for structural stability. Through cutting-edge technology. it enhances construction speed and reliability, underscoring SOBHA’s commitment to building with permanence and purpose.
